name: AntiBot Redirect
description: Redirects visitors to a reCAPTCHA verify page before serving configured paths when the request has no same-site Referer.
project_description: AntiBot Redirect gates a configurable list of front-end paths behind a reCAPTCHA "verify you are human" page. A kernel REQUEST event subscriber inspects each main request: if the path matches one of the configured protected paths (newline list, wildcard '*' supported) and the request's Referer header does not point back to the site's own base URL, the visitor is redirected to '/verify-human?destination=<original-uri>'. That page (AntibotCheckForm) renders an optional admin-configured description plus a recaptcha/reCAPTCHA CAPTCHA element; on successful submission it stores 'verified_human' = TRUE in the session and redirects to the original destination, after which protected paths are served normally for the rest of the session. Requires the reCAPTCHA (recaptcha) contrib module for the CAPTCHA challenge. Settings live at /admin/config/system/antibot-redirect and are gated by 'administer site configuration'. Works on Drupal 10 and 11.
